scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind energy-saving technology.
Energy-efficient bulb: uses less electricity for similar light. Switch off: saves power when a device is not needed.
Solar charger: uses energy from sunlight. Proper maintenance: helps devices work efficiently. Reuse: can reduce waste from usable equipment.
Create a class safety demonstration. Show a good example of energy-efficient bulb and switch off and explain why the good practice matters.
